## Why visit

A purposeful excursion for contemporary beer and the opportunity to see a production brewery. The taproom’s rotating own-beer range, small serving sizes and bookable tours give it more substance than a generic warehouse bar. For this trip it earns its place as a specialist tasting option, especially if you enjoy newer brewing styles alongside traditional cask. It sits outside the main pub clusters, so visit for a particular beer or confirmed tour rather than expecting to stumble across it while walking between old pubs.

## Beer

Craft keg from Azvex; CAMRA does not identify cask service. Do not treat the taproom as a real-ale destination.
